# bcdec

`bcdec.h` from https://github.com/iOrange/bcdec (v0.985, commit
80859ed3b7afb1c527a2a99d70c61457bea72d0c), unmodified but for a dropped byte
order mark. Decodes BC1-BC7 (DXT1-5, ATI1/2, BC6H, BC7) blocks; used by the
DDS, VTF and BLP decoders through `src/decoders/bcn.cpp`.
